sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle for direct PhD application with a UChicago bachelor’s completed before enrollment; no
external terminal MA or spring admission. International applicants are accepted. The department describes
preparation in calculus, linear algebra, complex analysis, real analysis, abstract algebra and point-set topology
as guidance rather than rigid prerequisites. F-1 status does not itself establish academic eligibility; grades and
degree completion remain to be assessed. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare the KSAS online application, transcripts, current/planned courses absent from transcripts, SOP and
three referees. Request the English waiver in the application, and any fee waiver before payment. Check prior
undergraduate attendance against the VTSI institution list if seeking that fellowship. No pre-application adviser
agreement is listed. [s3] [s4] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor agreement is listed before application. Contact program coordinator Kate Torrence or
mathematics@jhu.edu for mechanics; Fei Lu is current DGS. Relevant faculty and research community are
listed below. Research professors, lecturers, postdocs and emeriti are explicitly separated by appointment
caveats and must not be assumed ordinary primary PhD advisers. Ziquan Zhuang has moved to Stanford and
Haihan Wu to Virginia despite stale JHU directory entries. [s1] [s16] [s20] [f20] [f21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use KSAS application via How to Apply; documents and recommendations are electronic. Central guidance
says no paper materials unless requested, while an old Math FAQ still gives a paper-mail address: follow
current electronic checklist and obtain instructions before mailing. Offer response: status page → View Update
→ offer portal → enrollment decision. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]

Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application explicitly confirmed, December 15, 2026; VTSI December 1, 2026. University funding
figures are 2026-27 and contract initially expires June 30, 2027. Most reference mechanics and essay
formatting are standing/portal-only. [s1] [s9] [s11]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL or IELTS unless exempt; department minimum TOEFL 100 on the old scale or 5 on the new scale, IELTS
7. Central page retains preferred TOEFL 100/IELTS 7 and requires scores less than two years old. Codes: TOEFL
5332; IELTS 4610. Send official results directly; IELTS applicants also upload a copy, while TOEFL student
copies/photocopies are not accepted in lieu of official reporting. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s qualifies assuming at least two years of full-time US study; request waiver inside the
application. Department explicitly includes applicants completing the bachelor’s. Central international
instructions require a current US degree to be conferred within two semesters of application; confirm
interpretation for UChicago quarters and your actual conferral date if outside normal spring/summer 2027
graduation. [s2] [s4] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Mathematics on the central exam table. Public sources do not clearly distinguish whether
unsolicited General GRE scores are considered or ignored; do not label it prohibited or recommended. [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional and regarded as useful by Mathematics; more weight is placed on other application elements if
absent. Self-report suffices when applying, with official verification only if accepted. No published Math GRE
minimum located. Central GRE validity is five years. [s1] [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial transcripts for all previous college/university study. Non-English records need the original plus
professional third-party English translation. Study-abroad transcripts can be omitted when courses and credits
appear on the primary university transcript. Add current/planned courses absent from the transcript. After
accepting, arrange official transcripts sent directly by institutions; delayed final records can block registration.
Foreign-work credential evaluations are strongly recommended, not a replacement for transcripts; UChicago
itself is US study. [s3] [s5] [s6]

Required list of current courses and future courses before enrollment that do not appear on the transcript. A

template, textbook requirement, file type or precise upload field; verify those in the application. [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required. Mathematics says the online system accepts three; an additional recommender can email the
department through the FAQ contact link. Standard online recommendation form must be completed. Do not
assume an extra letter or a dossier-service PDF substitutes for the form. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra Owen reference is listed. VTSI requires all reference letters by December 1, 2026 along with its
supplement, but the public VTSI instructions do not publish extra-reference count or distinct referee questions.
Other supplemental fellowship nomination/reference rules are not specified. UChicago-only undergraduate
attendance does not establish VTSI eligibility. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s13]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Central instructions say adding a recommender’s email in the application requests an electronic
recommendation and sends instructions. The precise save/send action and whether merely entering details
immediately triggers email are not stated publicly. Obtain referee consent before activating the request. [s3]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
KSAS public instructions do not establish an after-submission-only rule or the exact pre-submission trigger.
Shared-portal School of Education guidance allows application submission while letters are outstanding, but
this is cross-division evidence, not a confirmed KSAS workflow. Math deadlines still apply to letters. [s3] [s15] [s1]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The shared applygrad portal’s School of Education FAQ describes an application-status checklist after
submission with each letter marked submitted/received and a green check. KSAS finalization confirms a status
page exists, but public KSAS instructions do not independently document letter receipt indicators; verify in
your own checklist and contact admissions for unmatched letters. [s15] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
KSAS requires separate reference uploads for each program application and does not share admissions files.
Reuse from an earlier cycle, Interfolio compatibility, replacement after submission and referee-edit permissions
were not established by targeted public searches. Ask the department before requesting replacement; do not
assume an old letter carries forward. [s3] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current 2026-27 contractual minimum USD 52,000 annually for a full fiscal-year appointment (12-month
annual basis), with proration for shorter/partial appointments; not a confirmed Fall 2027 offer. Math guarantees
full tuition and benefits with support. Owen supplement is USD 6,000/year for three years for selected
exceptional applicants. Central 2026-27 cost page says resident full-time PhD health insurance is covered;
tuition/insurance value is not extra cash. The agreement’s initial term ends June 30, 2027, with conditional
automatic renewal, so 2027-28 rate must be rechecked. [s1] [s8] [s9] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years of support conditional on satisfactory progress; sixth-year support generally possible for students on
track who would benefit, but not an unconditional sixth-year guarantee. First year is TA-free and an additional
dissertation-stage semester is teaching-free. VTSI, for eligible selected applicants, offers up to six years. [s2]
[s17]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Mathematics says all admitted PhD students receive support and explicitly admits international students.
Contract includes international employees and immigration-related assistance. Need-based relocation
maximum is USD 2,500 for international entrants versus USD 2,000 domestic; award requires admission,
financial need and eventual matriculation. Funding-specific external citizenship restrictions still need checking.
[s1] [s2] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain full-time resident enrollment, satisfactory academic progress and assigned employment duties. TA
duties are normally required after year one; contract average work cap is 20 hours/week, distinct from
academic study. Teaching seminar is normally first year; written algebra/analysis exams by start of year two,
oral research exam by April 10 of year three. Sixth year is conditional. Outside earnings and appointments
remain subject to institutional/funder and immigration rules. [s2] [s9] [s14]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Regular PhD support is automatic with admission; no extra Owen application listed. VTSI needs its supplement
and early complete file; eligible applicants receive a fee waiver through the application. Relocation application
link is emailed within 48 hours of an admission offer, with one request even for multiple admitted programs,
and payment depends on enrollment. Other supplemental nomination procedures are not public. [s1] [s10] [s11]
[s13]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Owen supplement; summer teaching for extra income; university-wide fellowships. Beverly Wendland
Fellowship advertises USD 12,000 over two years in natural sciences for candidates facing barriers, with exact
nomination/eligibility details to confirm. Boggs requires HBCU undergraduate background and Posse Fellowship
requires Posse alumni status, neither established here. VTSI requires eligible institutional attendance. Contract
also describes dependent-health support, child/adult-dependent grants and international visa-renewal
assistance; external awards paid through JHU below the minimum are topped up during guaranteed funding.
[s1] [s8] [s9] [s13]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 75 per KSAS application, nonrefundable; Visa, Mastercard or Discover. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Request within application and upload proof of qualifying participation or hardship. Listed routes include

ABRCMS, Baltimore Scholars, departmental request, Explore Hopkins, GEM, IRT, JHU BioREU/current JHU
student, Mellon Mays, Penn State Millennium, MIT Laureates & Leaders, National Name Exchange, oSTEM,
Posse, SACNAS, UMBC Meyerhoff and veteran/active military. Hardship proof: FAFSA SAR, college
financial-aid-office letter, or unemployment verification; do not send tax returns. No KSAS citizenship exclusion
is stated; a UChicago aid-office letter may provide the applicable documented route, subject to approval.
Deadline, turnaround and after-submission timing are unverified. Eligible VTSI applicants receive portal
waivers. [s3] [s11]

Pay attention to
• All materials due December 15, 2026; VTSI December 1 applies only if eligible undergraduate attendance is
established.
• UChicago English exemption requires the in-application request and degree timing/full-time-study conditions.
• Math GRE optional, useful and self-reportable; official verification only upon acceptance.
• Current/planned courses absent from transcript must be provided.
• No public Math essay length was found; do not copy MFA or School of Education word limits.
• 2026-27 minimum is USD 52,000 annually; Fall 2027 funding rate remains unconfirmed.
• Zhuang and Haihan Wu have left despite JHU roster entries; Chi Li and Mee Seong Im hold research-professor
appointments.

emeritus contacts; no acceptance of new students inferred.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle for direct PhD application with a UChicago bachelor’s completed before enrollment; no
external terminal MA or spring admission. International applicants are accepted. The department describes
preparation in calculus, linear algebra, complex analysis, real analysis, abstract algebra and point-set topology
as guidance rather than rigid prerequisites. F-1 status does not itself establish academic eligibility; grades and
degree completion remain to be assessed. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare the KSAS online application, transcripts, current/planned courses absent from transcripts, SOP and
three referees. Request the English waiver in the application, and any fee waiver before payment. Check prior
undergraduate attendance against the VTSI institution list if seeking that fellowship. No pre-application adviser
agreement is listed. [s3] [s4] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor agreement is listed before application. Contact program coordinator Kate Torrence or
mathematics@jhu.edu for mechanics; Fei Lu is current DGS. Relevant faculty and research community are
listed below. Research professors, lecturers, postdocs and emeriti are explicitly separated by appointment
caveats and must not be assumed ordinary primary PhD advisers. Ziquan Zhuang has moved to Stanford and
Haihan Wu to Virginia despite stale JHU directory entries. [s1] [s16] [s20] [f20] [f21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use KSAS application via How to Apply; documents and recommendations are electronic. Central guidance
says no paper materials unless requested, while an old Math FAQ still gives a paper-mail address: follow
current electronic checklist and obtain instructions before mailing. Offer response: status page → View Update
→ offer portal → enrollment decision. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]

Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application explicitly confirmed, December 15, 2026; VTSI December 1, 2026. University funding
figures are 2026-27 and contract initially expires June 30, 2027. Most reference mechanics and essay
formatting are standing/portal-only. [s1] [s9] [s11]

Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027: all application materials must be received, including references. VTSI
applicants instead need the entire PhD application, supplement and all supporting materials/letters received
December 1, 2026. Exact cutoff time/timezone and any grace period are not published on the mathematics
page. [s1] [s11]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Regular departmental support accompanies admission; use the December 15, 2026 complete-file deadline.
VTSI has the earlier December 1, 2026 complete-file deadline. No separate Owen Fellowship deadline is listed.
Relocation grant applications become available only after admission; exact closing date is not public. [s1] [s10]
[s11]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL or IELTS unless exempt; department minimum TOEFL 100 on the old scale or 5 on the new scale, IELTS
7. Central page retains preferred TOEFL 100/IELTS 7 and requires scores less than two years old. Codes: TOEFL
5332; IELTS 4610. Send official results directly; IELTS applicants also upload a copy, while TOEFL student
copies/photocopies are not accepted in lieu of official reporting. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s qualifies assuming at least two years of full-time US study; request waiver inside the
application. Department explicitly includes applicants completing the bachelor’s. Central international
instructions require a current US degree to be conferred within two semesters of application; confirm
interpretation for UChicago quarters and your actual conferral date if outside normal spring/summer 2027
graduation. [s2] [s4] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Mathematics on the central exam table. Public sources do not clearly distinguish whether
unsolicited General GRE scores are considered or ignored; do not label it prohibited or recommended. [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional and regarded as useful by Mathematics; more weight is placed on other application elements if
absent. Self-report suffices when applying, with official verification only if accepted. No published Math GRE
minimum located. Central GRE validity is five years. [s1] [s2] [s4]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial transcripts for all previous college/university study. Non-English records need the original plus
professional third-party English translation. Study-abroad transcripts can be omitted when courses and credits
appear on the primary university transcript. Add current/planned courses absent from the transcript. After
accepting, arrange official transcripts sent directly by institutions; delayed final records can block registration.
Foreign-work credential evaluations are strongly recommended, not a replacement for transcripts; UChicago
itself is US study. [s3] [s5] [s6]

template, textbook requirement, file type or precise upload field; verify those in the application. [s3]

assume an extra letter or a dossier-service PDF substitutes for the form. [s1] [s2]

attendance does not establish VTSI eligibility. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s13]

Central instructions say adding a recommender’s email in the application requests an electronic

Current 2026-27 contractual minimum USD 52,000 annually for a full fiscal-year appointment (12-month

Five years of support conditional on satisfactory progress; sixth-year support generally possible for students on
